name: roksbnkctl-FAR-mirror
description: Replicate the BNK supply chain (F5's artifact registry) into a private OCI registry, then verify it — the mirror half of a disconnected install. Host-side registry-to-registry copy; no cluster required.

destroy.name: registry-delete
destroy.description: Empty the mirror. OFF by default, because the common case is that the registry is destroyed along with the mirror — when this module runs inside the Harbor blueprint, Harbor's own destroy removes the VSI and every artifact on it, so deleting 89 manifests first is work whose result is discarded. Turn it on when mirroring into a registry you do NOT own and want left clean. Bounded at 15 minutes: the registry may be unreachable by the time this runs, and a dropped packet to a closed port hangs until the kernel gives up rather than failing.

required.name: prefix
required.description: Prefix for resource names roksbnkctl creates (e.g. acme-eu).

required.name: region
required.description: Region the cluster lives in. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: resource_group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.description: IBM Cloud API key. Filled from the project's credential template at creation and carried by the module, so the module keeps working even if the project's template is cleared later.

optional.name: manifest_version
optional.description: BNK manifest release to install. Blank = the roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: cos_instance
optional.description: COS instance holding the FAR auth key + subscription JWT. Blank = bnk-supply-chain.

optional.name: cos_bucket
optional.description: Bucket holding the FAR auth key + subscription JWT. Blank = bnk-artifacts. Account-suffixed buckets (bnk-artifacts-<account>) must be named explicitly.

optional.name: cos_region
optional.description: Region of that bucket. Blank = us-south.

optional.name: far_auth_file
optional.description: Object name of the FAR auth tarball in the bucket. Blank = f5-far-auth-key.tgz.

optional.name: subscription_jwt_file
optional.description: Object name of the subscription JWT in the bucket. Blank = subscription.jwt.

optional.name: registry_target
optional.description: Mirror backend: generic (a private OCI registry such as Harbor) or icr.

optional.name: registry_generic_host
optional.description: The mirror's host — for an air-gapped cluster this is its PRIVATE IP or DNS name, reached over the Transit Gateway. When a harbor module is part of the same deployment Forge wires this from its output; supply it yourself when mirroring into a registry you already run.

optional.name: registry_repo_prefix
optional.description: Project / repository prefix inside the mirror (a Harbor project, an Artifactory repo key).

optional.name: registry_username
optional.description: Username the mirror is pushed to and pulled from.

optional.name: registry_password
optional.description: Password / access token for that user. Stored base64 in the workspace config, never logged.

optional.name: cluster_name
optional.description: Name or ID of the EXISTING ROKS cluster to adopt. It is never created and never destroyed by this blueprint.

optional.name: registry_ca_b64
optional.description: Base64 PEM of the private registry's CA. v1.35.0 REFUSES to auto-capture a self-signed mirror's CA over the wire, so supply it here (or pin it below) — this is the CA you generated for the registry. When a harbor module is part of the same deployment Forge wires this from its output; supply it yourself when mirroring into a registry you already run.

optional.name: registry_ca_sha256
optional.description: SHA-256 pin of the registry's served chain, enforced during the TLS handshake. Accepts bare hex, sha256:…, colon-separated, or raw `openssl x509 -fingerprint -sha256` output.

optional.name: delete_artifacts_on_destroy
optional.description: Set true to delete every replicated artifact from the target registry when this module is destroyed. Leave empty when the registry is destroyed with it — emptying a registry that is about to be deleted only risks hanging the teardown.

optional.name: icr_host
optional.label: Icr host
optional.description: ICRHost overrides the IBM Container Registry host for target=icr (e.g. Maps to config.yaml registry.icr_host.

optional.name: icr_namespace
optional.label: Icr namespace
optional.description: The ICR namespace artifacts nest under for target=icr. Maps to config.yaml registry.icr_namespace.

optional.name: registry_include_deps
optional.label: Registry include deps
optional.description: IncludeDeps unions the non-F5 dependency artifacts (Jetstack cert-manager chart + images, the bitnami/kubectl node-labeler image) into the BOM. Maps to config.yaml registry.include_deps.

optional.name: registry_namespace
optional.label: Registry namespace
optional.description: The mirror project the artifacts land in. Maps to config.yaml registry.namespace.

optional.name: source_service_account_b64
optional.label: Source service account b64
optional.description: The FAR `_json_key_base64` service-account JSON, base64-encoded, used as the replication SOURCE credential for repo.f5.com. Maps to config.yaml registry.source_service_account_b64.
